company_info.company_description: "With over 20,000 successful installations, Unified Solar offers unmatched expertise for residential and commercial solar and battery projects.Founded and led by Rocco Romeo, renowned for his exceptional expertise in the solar industry, our handpicked team ensures top-quality work that meets his exacting standards. We're not just about sales; we deliver tailored, cutting-edge solar solutions to fit your unique energy needs.In a crowded market, we stand out with rigorous standards and a commitment to excellence. Choose Unified Solar Solutions and partner with a local family-owned business, dedicated to turning possibilities into realities."

reviews.review_description: We were contacted by Unified Solar Solutions within a few hours of requesting a quote through Solar Quotes and found Justin to be very honest with his suggestions for a battery install.The quote was very descriptive with lots of information and Brodie our installer was very polite, friendly and did a great job, cleaning up after himself and explaining the system and loading the app  for us.A very good experience had with Unified Solar Solutions  from start to finish.

From the quote from Harry which was great , with so much knowledge , grid connection was all organised , so was all up and running at install , the guys left everything so tidy (I’m sure it was cleaner when they left than when they arrived ) ? everyone we dealt with was so helpful which made it seamless , highly recommend them great job done by all
Punctual and great communication.Came back to give me a tutorial on the app.Have already recommended them.
Quoting was easy, their employee came to the house and explained everything. Happy with the final product

From start to finish Unified Solar Solutions were a pleasure to business with. Very professional, always on time and no upselling. No internet quoting their electrical engineer came and surveyed the site of installation and made sure that he quoted on exactly what was required. I have no hesitation in giving the 5 stars for every facet of the job.
Everything went as i had hoped with the minimum of fuss and professionalismI will have no hesitation in recommending united solar to others now and into the futureThank you
Todate we have only received a quote and we have placed an order with USS. Installation date yet to be advised.

Sales process was good. Gave the options and prices. No pressure(unlike some others).Installation was professionally completed. Unit was delayed due to stock availability. The boss rang me personally to apologise.Communication was easy and always prompt and professional.Customer service great.

I recently had 24kW Sigenergy batteries and a 10kW inverter installed by Unified Solar Solutions to complement my existing solar panel setup—and I couldn’t be happier! From the initial quote to the consultation and final installation, the entire process was seamless and professional. The team was knowledgeable, communicative, and efficient, making the upgrade stress-free and smooth. I’m now enjoying enhanced energy independence and peace of mind knowing my system is backed by top-tier technology. Highly recommend Unified Solar Solutions for anyone looking to level up their solar game!
Great service and installation. Solar and battery installed in one hit with no fuss.Very flexible and easy to work with.

Byd battery install onto existing fronius gen 24.Quoting process was seamless. Wayne took the time to discuss our needs in detail. When deciding of which of our three quotes to go for, I was very comfortable in going with unified solar. Admin was also top notch. Booking in the intake was easy and any payment was followed up with a timely receiptProfessional install. All wiring and conduit was neat and tidy.Unified followed up after the install to see how everything was going and to remind us to get in touch if we ever have any issues.Very good experience.
Very professional and punctual every thing was organised and done with little fuss

A prompt and efficient process to replace existing solar panels and add a battery. The job was completed in good order within one day the existing panels and rails were removed, new rails, panels and battery installed. The installation team were punctual, polite and they left the place clean and tidy. I found customer liaison to be very good throughout. The lead technician commissioned the new system and then assisted loading the app and showed me the features to use it. I am very happy with the job at this time.

Unified Solar Solutions were great from start to finish. They are a local family owned business who were very helpful and most importantly to me, were honest! I have since referred a friend to use them, which is not something I normally do. I also received a courtesy call the other day to ensure everything was ok and that I didn't have any issues. I have no problem recommending them.All mess was cleaned up at completion, which unfortunately doesn't happen quite often. The workers were friendly, polite and punctual and I was shown the ins and outs of the system. I would use them again.

All around quality service, no high-pressure sales technique.When I told their engineer that I needed time to research the products they would install before I signed up, he wasn't fazed. When I asked about lead time and said I want the truth, not just a short time frame to get me on board, he stated it could be up to three months due to a shortage of batteries. After researching, I signed up.Communication was excellent. Within four weeks, the United Solar crew was here on time, polite, and professional.No mess, no stress. What an absolute pleasure it was to have United Solar do our system.I would highly recommend them.

Discussed a number of options tailored for my needs and patient to understand what I wanted with several iterative system design. Good knowledge of options and consultant had good experience to guide the discussion as I didn’t know where to start.Installation was straightforward and completed without fuss
Paid deposit 05/08/2025. Have no installation date yet.

Couldn't fault their customer service.Friendly efficient and knowledgeable Salesman. Found out what we wanted, not what they wanted to sell, then advised what we needed to know. Wasn't pushy or forceful, let his product and service win the quote. Followed up.Installers were on time, friendly and knowledgeable about their product and where it was to go and how we wanted it set up. They weren't rushed and spent the time to explain how the app worked and provided contact details if we had any further questions after they had left.Very happy with USS, will definitely get them to quote on a heat pump when we are ready.

I’ve had an excellent experience with Unified Solar Solutions. From my very first interaction with Dickson, the team took the time to understand my needs, answer all my questions, and provide clear, unbiased advice. They were committed to delivering the best outcome by using high-quality products and ensuring a professional installation.The onsite installation team was courteous, respectful, and efficient, completing the work seamlessly while leaving my home spotless.I would have no hesitation in recommending Unified Solar Solutions to anyone seeking a reliable, high-quality, and competitively priced solar or battery solution for either residential or commercial projects

Fantastic experience from the beginning to the end. We had a visit from Unified Solar Solutions “designer” who helped us plan the best solution for our home and budget.We were presented with three options on our quote depending what brand we wished to choose. Installers were friendly, efficient and helped us set up the app.We required after sales support for a minor problem and it was fixed the same day!Can’t fault this company!Highly recommend to anyone currently on their solar journey
The team of installers were efficient and friendly. They were polite and respectful. They were very careful and left the place clean after the work was completed.
Very prompt, good system for managing communications, came when they said they would and left the place nice a tidy!

My solar and battery were installed by Unified Solar Solutions on Tuesday and I couldn’t speak highly enough of the team who came to do it. They were polite, friendly and went above and beyond with the install. My meter box needed modifications and that was done with no fuss or additional cost to me. When they left, other than having solar panels, a battery and inverter which I didn’t at the start of the day you wouldn’t have known they’d been because they cleaned and tidied up everything. Despite lots of cloud cover yesterday the system was working beautifully and by the end of the day the battery was full and I’d had power going to the grid. I can highly recommend Unified to anyone considering solar. From the initial discussions/quoting stage to installation the company was informative, competitively priced and the staff very easy to deal with. At the end of the day everything was explained to me in detail as well. I had done lots of research to get to the point of quote acceptance and install and I’m very pleased I picked Unified Solar, who were also a recommendation of SolarQuotes. Now my fave pastime is watching the App and seeing the power flowing into from those panels into the battery and to the grid

Unified Solar Solutions were great through the whole process. Very informative and polite. They were punctual and cleaned during the installation of our batteries. They would show us through the whole process and helped us with the app on our phone and how to interpret readings. Can not fault this company at all and the best is that they are a local Adelaide company which we can contact and get help  if needed.

Teams meeting for design worked well enough. Installer was on time and organised. Because there was no site visit during the design, we assumed the size of the consumer mains, which turned out to be smaller that expected. This meant a smaller inverter needed to be sourced and the production expectations adjusted accordingly. Quote included now obsolete home monitoring hardware and there was a little bit of confusion whether the one we were supplied with was going to do the job in the same way. So far it has been working fine.

From the first interaction to the install everything was made clear and easy to understand, we went over the cost vs benefits and came up with unified as our preferred installer and very happy that we did.Follow ups and all interactions have been great and unlike other providers we didn't feel pressured into this at all.Great and would recommend them again to anyone I know. The installer Chris is already booked for another job I needed done as I appreciated his clear explanations and the quality job him and his guys did on the day.

Quoting process was quick, they understood what I wanted, they followed up to make sure I was happy, they gave me a good price. They contacted me to start with.Installation went well. They brough a crew of 4 and completed the installation in a day - 7:45am to 4pm. They were very polite, they got on with the job and new when to come and discuss issues with me. They kept everything tidy and removed the large volume of packaging and didn't stuff it into my wheelie bins.They are helping me with the grid connection and helped me set up the app and how to use it.
Great all round service and installation.Knowledgeable, friendly, and polite

Salesman was helpful, providing extensive information about our options. He provided multiple quotes on different brands of systems. He answered all the questions we had over the course of the decision making process - which was about a month for us.We also met with other companies and their sales people and received quotes.Installation was very straightforward for us as home owner. Installers were polite and friendly.The only minor issue was gaining access to the monitoring app, and the installers customer service staff were quick to respond and resolve the issue.

Hard to comment on value and quality as system was only installed last week, but by all means everything has been great so far. Customer service and installation was above my expectations. Rocco and the sparky (cant remember his name) were great too.

Competitive and informative quote. Communication with the admin and tradesmen was good. Handover information on completion was clear and easy to follow. Admin kept in touch regarding connection with power supply company and any other concerns.

Not the cheapest of the quotes received (but close). Took the time to listen, and ask questions.  Advice provided in plain language, and documentation clear and easily understood.  Communication of options and pros/cons of each option clearly outlined. Delivered when they promised, and came back promptly to rectify a minor configuration issue.  Staff polite and efficient.  Instructions on usage of equipment clearly understood.  Overall, good service.

The salesperson was prompt with the response to the quote request. And he followed up promptly with a revised scope. And he was quick to advise us of some added rebates that became available.The installation went through very efficiently. There were 3 staff on site and the whole install took a little over 6 hours.The system was activated immediately upon job completion.There has been a follow up contact to check in and see how it is performing.All in all very satisfied thank you .

Unified Solar Solutions were amazing to deal with from day 1.They attended onsite within a few days of first contact, reviewed the property and discussed multiple options.Written and detailed quotations were given along with follow up phone calls and queries answered.Installation was locked in was undertaken on time and efficiently with great workmanship.Thank USS.

In every category, from the initial visit by the electrician to the installation, Unified Solar Solutions performed superbly. Polite, respectful and extremely patient. A business that exudes with integrity. Very reliable and relational. Highly recommended
Informative, great updates on scheduling, great service, kept appointment times, not pushy, answered all questions, sales person went on holidays, ensured had contact in his absence

My experience with Unified Solar was absolutely amazing.  Wayne was patient enough to talk me through the process, answered all my queries and provided me with the best options (both on quality and price). Rocco and his crew were brilliant with the installation and I thought the workmanship was top-notch. The support from Maggie was also exceptional. She kept me informed and was prompt in responding. I couldn't thank them enough. Highly recommended.
Rob was very down to earth and easy to deal with,  he was precise and punctual and happy to answer any questions we had. Booking and installation was easy, very happy with the service.
Very easy to deal with, fast installation and a great product. All staff are very friendly and eager to help

All staff are incredible. Friendly and respectful. The service is very high quality and the installers were just so wonderful and easy to deal with. All staff we had interaction with, just brilliant!Very helpful with how to use the system and the apps after as well.

Quoting process was quick and easy. A little difficult telling the unsuccessful companies.The installation was as they said, one full day arrived at 0730 gone at 1630...great work! system connected and functioning perfectly.crew was clean, tidy and very friendly.

I had a great experience with Rocco and the team. All my questions were diligently answered and I never felt pressured to "lock" anything in before I was ready.I was happy to pay slightly more for the system as I felt I ended up with a better product and superior installation overall. Even on the day of install Rocco tweaked the placement realizing he could get a better result!Thanks team!
From start to end, great process and customer service, very low bills after.

The quote was provided in a timely manner and the installation scheduled to meet my requirements. The installation went smoothly with the guys all working very well. They were all respectful and easy to communicate a great bunch.

The sales/quotation, pre-install and install with Unified went very well.Dion was excellent and made the decision making process very easy.The admin support leading up to the install was excellent.The installer was punctual and very efficient.My only negative comment would be the multiple prompts via email and SMS a few days after install re: my invoice being overdue despite having already paid it on the day of install and had provided the transaction receipt to USS. Although I’m putting this down to the time of year, being around Xmas, office shut down and it being an automated function, it was still an unnecessary way to finish up what was a positive, easy, efficient and smooth process up to that point.
Great installer, all the guys were very polite, efficient and very tidy. Happy with the complete service.

Sales quote process completed via phone.Initial installation was fast and professional. Couple of issues in initial set up with inverters not operating fully and grid connection but all was eventually resolved and operating.USS techs were friendly and helpful and got the job done.

Online approach.Prompt attention, as an —- customer, received extra $1k discount.From scratch to install took 2 weeks, including Solar Vic paperwork.Arranged grid connections.Very happy with all aspects.
